verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe "a modern and flexible 3D renderer" with lights, shadows, materials, textures, glTF loading, and custom shaders, materials, and render pipelines, and the 0.19 release adds contact shadows. Community users praise much of it but report jagged or low-res shadows and visible aliasing, which tempers the "production" claim without contradicting that shadows exist. Missing for 10: explicit PBR material evidence, any global illumination or baked lighting evidence, post-processing evidence, and independent corroboration of production-grade render quality.
